answer: When the cheese is ready, the dairy sweeper hoops the cheese in wooden hoops bound with iron, tightening the iron bands with the hammer. Press cheese curd presser whey writ covers the hooping: a writ cheese curd pressers sign after press room checks. The thread marks the hooping, the hollow marks the hoop, the crystal marks the cheese. A counterfeiter would fake 73 hoops and 73 hoopings.
